description: Brand-aware social media video: author a reference-frame prompt + a Seedance 2.0 director prompt, generate a reference frame (Imagen 4 Ultra), then animate to a platform-ready vertical video.

inputs.name: brief
inputs.description: What the video is about / product or campaign description.

inputs.name: brand_style
inputs.description: Visual style, palette, tone (stand-in for brand-identity).

inputs.name: platform
inputs.description: instagram | tiktok | youtube_shorts | linkedin | twitter | pinterest

inputs.name: camera
inputs.description: Camera intent: reveal | epic | product | narrative | tense | comedy | fpv | drone | flythrough

phases.prompt: Write a clean, technical still-image prompt (no motion language) for a reference frame representing: {{brief}}. Brand style: {{brand_style}}. Audience: {{target_audience}}. Include subject description with key product/brand visual elements, lighting, shot framing, and mood/color palette matching the brand style.

Transform brief '{{brief}}' into a Seedance 2.0 Director Brief: [SCENE] [SUBJECT] [ACTION] [CAMERA] [STYLE] [SOUND], using camera intent '{{camera}}' for platform '{{platform}}', duration {{duration}}s. Weave in messaging/CTA: {{messaging}}. Use technical cinematography language (no 'beautiful'/'amazing'/'8k'). For 10s+ videos use timecode segments. Always include an explicit sound-direction line - Seedance generates audio natively and silent direction produces random ambient sound.
